name: If We Meet Again
source:
Kiran (they/them) is an owl and graduate student studying the new field of magical physics dubbed the study of "fate-time." They keep seeing a lover from a past life in their dreams, and secretly, they are searching for answers as to who this woman is, and whether she ever even existed. Leo (he/him), on the other hand, is a visiting student from the country of demons who's just here to do his job and go home. Things might not turn out as planned, but were they already written in the threads of fate? 

[From [url=https://bigflatcabbage.itch.io/if-we-meet-again]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
基兰（他们/他们）是一只猫头鹰和研究生，研究被称为“命运时间”的魔法物理新领域。他们不断在梦中见到前世的情人，并暗自寻找这个女人是谁，以及她是否存在过的答案。另一方面，利奥（他/他）是来自恶魔之国的访问学生，他只是来这里完成工作并回家。事情也许不会如计划的那样发展，但它们是否已经被写在命运的丝线里了？

[来自[url=https://bigflatcabbage.itch.io/if-we-meet-again]itch.io[/url]]
